messages:
Zoe: Drafted a tiny update for the Region Availability doc — adding a short 'locale checklist' row and two minimal SDK examples (py/js). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1012. Can Legal confirm residency blurb?

Marta (Docs): I can trim copy for i18n. Suggest we keep the blurb under 110 chars and use the canonical country display names from the locale table.

Jin (Platform): Use header `X-Redwood-Region` in all examples; public examples should use `eu-west-1` / `na-ash-1` / `apac-sg-1` as canonical ids. Avoid private-base-url in public snippets. Example curl: `curl -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate`

Legal-Bot: Recommended line: "Request logs are retained for up to 30 days for operational troubleshooting and abuse prevention." Do not state residency guarantees.

Zoe: Thanks — updated PR with that exact sentence and added one-line Python/JS snippets. Will @Marta when final so she can extract i18n keys.

Marta (Docs): LGTM, will merge after CI passes. Filing a follow-up issue to replace legacy query-param examples in `/docs/samples/region-examples.md`.

Zoe: Merged after CI green. Added PR note to contact Support for contractual residency needs. :white_check_mark:
